description: This file defines a protocol for explorable data sources in Superset, including method signatures and metadata properties for querying, security, caching, and metadata representation.

classes.name: TimeGrainDict
classes.description: TypedDict representing time grain options for temporal data grouping.

classes.name: Explorable
classes.description: Protocol defining the interface for explorable data sources in Superset.

methods.name: get_query_result
methods.description: Executes a query and returns the results as a QueryResult object.

methods.name: get_query_str
methods.description: Returns the query string for a given query object without executing it.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Property returning the primary key identifier for the explorable.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Property returning a unique string identifier for the explorable.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Property returning the type discriminator of the explorable.

methods.name: metrics
methods.description: Property returning a list of metric metadata objects.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Property returning a list of column metadata objects.

methods.name: column_names
methods.description: Property returning a list of column name strings.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Property returning the full metadata dictionary for frontend use.

methods.name: cache_timeout
methods.description: Property returning the default cache timeout in seconds.

methods.name: changed_on
methods.description: Property returning the last modification timestamp.

methods.name: get_extra_cache_keys
methods.description: Method returning additional cache key components based on the query.

methods.name: perm
methods.description: Property returning the permission string for security checks.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Property returning timezone offset in seconds.

methods.name: get_time_grains
methods.description: Method returning a list of time grain options for temporal grouping.

methods.name: has_drill_by_columns
methods.description: Method to check if specified columns support drill-by operations.

methods.name: is_rls_supported
methods.description: Property indicating if Row Level Security is supported.

methods.name: query_language
methods.description: Property indicating the query language used for syntax highlighting.
